sentences.text:
THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MRS. K.S.MUDAGAL  and  HON'BLE MR JUSTICE VIJAYKUMAR A. PATIL  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MRS. K.S.MUDAGAL)
The appellants are the wife, children and parents of deceased S.Sudheendra alias Sudheendra Gowda.

On 18.03.2017 at 09:05 a.m. when he was proceeding on motorcycle bearing Reg.No.MH-06-2556 at Tatireddipalli Cross on Bengaluru-Palamaner NH-69 road, Gangavarm Mandal, Chittoor District, Andhra Pradesh, he met with the accident.

2. It was alleged that the rider of motorcycle bearing Reg.No.KA-51-D-7300 hit the motorcycle of Sudheendra Gowda from hind side, consequently, he fell NC: 2025:KHC:19429-DB HC-KAR down on the road, by that time Volvo bus bearing Reg.No.KA-01-AF-5695 coming from the opposite direction, ran over him and caused his death.
The rashness and negligence were imputed to rider of Reg.No.MH-06-2556 and Volvo bus bearing Reg.No.KA-01- AF-5695.

The Tribunal by the impugned award imputed 30% rashness and negligence to the driver of Volvo bus and 70% to the deceased himself.
3.
Respondent Nos.1 & 2 are the registered owners of Volvo bus bearing Reg.No.KA-01-AF-5695 and motorcycle No.KA-51-D-7300.
The appellants have challenged the finding of 70% negligence on the part of deceased himself.
Before this Court, the insurer of Volvo bus is impleaded for the first time as respondent No.4.
Respondent No.4 needs to be given opportunity to file its statement of objections and defend the case.

The Tribunal has to implead him as respondent No.4, therefore, the matter requires to be remanded to the Tribunal for reconsideration after impleading the present Smt Rajeshwari vs M/S Komitla Service on 9 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17151730/
3 respondent No.4 as respondent No.4 in the petition also.
